title: Tree-cut decompositions for displaying undominated edge-ends
summary: We prove that every graph admits a linked, componental, rooted tree-cut decomposition of finite adhesion that displays all undominated edge-ends. As a first application, we deduce that this tree-cut decomposition also displays the edge-degrees of all undominated edge-ends. For locally finite graphs $-$ where every end is an undominated edge-end $-$ this yields a linked tree-cut decomposition of finite adhesion into $\textit{finite}$ parts that displays all ends and their edge-degrees.
